data.body:
Fixes bug B-decision-extends-mutates-old-record: Seen 2026-10-23 recording D-recovery-one-design with --extends D-orphan-recovery: output 'added to D-orphan-recovery (decision, extends): no new record was made; globs added to it'. The new decision text was dropped and the old record's globs silently grew by ddflow/api/lifecycle/**. help says 'filed as a NEW record linked to ID'. Workaround: --new then 'ddflow link --extends'. Expected: a new record linked extends (as the help and the dedupe review's DX-decision-amend-relation imply), or a refusal that does not edit the old record.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-decision-extends-mutates-old-record --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-decision-extends-mutates-old-record --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B-decision-extends-mutates-old-record: decision add --extends ID appends to the old decision (adds its globs)...

data.claim: decision add --extends ID appends to ID (mutating it) whenever ID is still extendable, because `_dedupe._point` treats `extends` as an append for kinds outside LINK_ONLY_KINDS, which excludes decision.
data.falsifier: The probe returns a NEW record id D-new with an `extends` link to D-old and D-old's globs unchanged; or the probe shows D-old's globs grew with no D-new record.
data.mechanism: In _dedupe._point the append branch is `extendable(...) and (relation in (merge_into, duplicate_of) or tkind not in LINK_ONLY_KINDS)`; a decision has tkind='decision' (not in task/phase/research), so `extends` satisfies `tkind not in LINK_ONLY_KINDS` and calls `extend`, which appends text and unions globs onto D-old.
data.probe: python probe calling A.decision_add(D-old, globs='src/a.py') then A.decision_add(D-new, globs='src/a.py,src/b.py', answer=Answer('extends','D-old'))
data.probe_output: exit=0, data={id: D-old, extended: D-old, relation: extends, globs_added: [src/b.py]}; no D-new record, D-old globs unioned
data.question: Does `decision add --extends ID` currently append the new decision text to ID and union the new globs onto it (no new record), instead of filing a new decision linked to ID?

evidence.note: CONFIRMED probe: A.decision_add(D-old, globs='src/a.py') then A.decision_add(D-new, globs='src/a.py,src/b.py', answer=Answer('extends','D-old')) returned exit=0 data={id:'D-old',extended:'D-old',relation:'extends',globs_added:['src/b.py']} - no D-new record, D-old globs grew to ['src/a.py','src/b.py']. Cause: _dedupe._point appends for tkind not in LINK_ONLY_KINDS (task,phase,research), so a decision (extendable) is appended to instead of filing a new record. Research note R-fix-B-decision-extends-mutates-old-record CONFIRMED.

Ran ddflow brief --item fix-B-decision-extends-mutates-old-record. Relevant project rules: r-reuse-core (this fix reuses the existing _dedupe._point / extend machinery, changing only the constant and one condition; no new behaviour written twice); r-small-files (_dedupe.py stays ~478 lines, well under the 30KB split limit); r-no-shell (no shell dependency added). Governing decision D-no-deletion: 'A decision extension files a new record and never edits the old one'. Fix aligns decision with task/phase/research (LINK_ONLY_KINDS).

Committed 3ac17de51. Changed ddflow/api/_dedupe.py LINK_ONLY_KINDS to include 'decision' so `extends` files a new record linked to a decision (D-no-deletion) instead of appending; update _dedupe module docstring; rewrote decision-extends tests in tests/test_extend_globs.py (regression: test_decision_extends_files_a_new_linked_record_and_leaves_the_target) and added ddflow_decision_add to LINK_ONLY in tests/test_add_dedupe_mcp.py.
